_: Planted red/green controls for the CLI wiring (main/exit), which every other test in the suite never reaches — they exercise analyzeTitle()/extractAddedTitles()/splitByFile() directly or drive collectOffenders via a synthetic diff string, never the spawned process. The two entries here grade only the two spawned `CONTROL:` tests.

expectRed: control: a staged test file with a disallowed title blocks with exit 1
mutations.note: Forces main()'s offender branch to exit 0 instead of 1 — the guard reports the violating title but never blocks.

expectRed: control: a staged test file with a permitted title passes with exit 0
mutations.note: Forces main() to always take the offender branch, regardless of collectOffenders()'s result — a clean staged title also blocks.
